cd /home/mkinney/repos/OpenZenith && git add -A && git commit -m "fix: theme toggle root cause, features grid centering, support section update

Theme Toggle (actual fix):
- Root cause: setThemeMode() wrote to localStorage and called notifyAll(),
  but getSnapshot() read modeRef.current (per-instance ref) which was never
  updated by setThemeMode(). The module-level currentMode variable was always
  'system', so toggle had no effect on React state.
- Fix: Replaced per-instance modeRef with module-level shared 'currentMode'
  variable. setThemeMode() now writes to currentMode directly, which is what
  getSnapshot() reads. All useTheme() instances share the same source of truth.
- Added initTheme() called once on mount to read localStorage into currentMode
  and apply data-theme attribute before first render.
- Removed broken useEffect+notifyAll() pattern from useTheme() hook body.
- OS preference listener only triggers re-render when mode is 'system'.

Theme Toggle Icon:
- Clean SVG icons (sun/moon) already applied in previous commit.

Features Grid Centering:
- Changed oz-features-grid from CSS Grid to Flexbox with justify-content: center
- Items use width: calc(33.333% - 0.67rem) with min-width: 240px
- Full rows stay aligned (items fill to 33%); orphaned items center
- Responsive: 50% on tablet, 100% on mobile

FlipCard Height Consistency:
- Replaced minHeight prop with fixed height prop
- Removed unreliable useLayoutEffect measurement hack that toggled
  position:relative/absolute during layout (caused varying heights)
- All feature cards now use height={150}, guaranteeing uniform rows
- Added overflow:hidden to prevent content spill

Support Section Update:
- Updated description: removed false claim 'no databases' — R2 stores
  ~1.7GB of elevation tiles as object storage
- New text: 'Elevation tiles live in Cloudflare R2 (~1.7GB), API responses
  are cached at the edge, and everything else executes in your browser'
- Added 'User Accounts' card: save preferences, bookmarks, custom maps
  across devices, higher rate limits. Notes it requires database + auth.
- Updated closing text: mentions accounts/persistence are on the roadmap
  once the platform is proven out" && git push 2>&1
